info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Treasury Management API
info.description: The Corporate Treasury Management API provides clients with access to essential treasury functions, allowing for efficient cash management, liquidity planning, and risk assessment. Users can retrieve vital information related to treasury operations, including cash balances, funding strategies, and investment opportunities. Typically utilized by corporate financial departments and treasury managers, this API supports informed decision-making and improved financial oversight. Whether assessing cash positions or monitoring net cash flow, developers can leverage this endpoint to enhance treasury operations.
